_doc: WMT-specific corrections layered over Byron's 3k_shared.map (the base 3k_map.db, which is fully regenerated/overwritten on each map pull). These overrides are applied SERVER-SIDE at load — they survive a re-pull and are versioned here. Edit + redeploy server (or hot-reload) to apply.

_schema.hideExits: [{vnum, dir, note}] — drop a bogus/broken/non-navigational exit so it's neither drawn nor followed (e.g. an in-game action mis-recorded as an exit).
_schema.addExits: [{from, dir, to, cmd?, note}] — add or rewire a connection the base map gets wrong.
_schema._: Room-name and POI overrides can be added later; kept to exits for now.

hideExits.note: Celestial Zodiacs 'Shrine of Celestial Grace' (E of Threshold): light/leave are in Byron's map but NOT in-game (Nathan 2026-06-22) — artifact.

Celestial Zodiacs 'Sanctuary of Basket': 'portal' is a DYNAMIC random exit that can open in ANY room (after light, before Aeonos) leading to a treasure room — NOT fixed to this room. Byron hardcoded it here (pointing at 53589, which isn't even in the map). Hide so we don't misrepresent it as always-present in one room. Nathan 2026-06-22.

addExits.note: Celestial Zodiacs Aeonos floor: after killing Aeonos, a 2nd 'swim' from 'The Depths of the Reflecting Pool' (53915) is a ONE-WAY return to 'The Atrium' (53587, the 'light' main entrance). Byron's map only records 53915 up->53914 (Aeonos); the swim return is missing. Path is 53914 --swim--> 53915 --swim--> 53587. Nathan 2026-06-22.
